purpose: Review city-local registry basis and anonymous geometry-only routes without querying personal/property attributes.
registryBasis: An Egyptian Ministry of Finance government document listing Dakahlia service locations names “Mit Ghamr Real Estate Publicity Office” (مأمورية شهر ميت غمر) at the court building, alongside a local Mit Ghamr documentation branch. This supports a local real-estate registration/publicity service. Official map evidence found for Mit al-Ezz is a detailed village planning-map amendment within Mit Ghamr Center, not city cadastral polygons; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was verified.
assessment: Local real-estate publicity service is evidenced, but no public anonymous cadastral polygon service or safe parcel schema was verified. The Mit al-Ezz plan is not attributed to the WUP city point as parcel geometry.

officialSources.observation: The Ministry of Finance hosted service-location document lists a Mit Ghamr Real Estate Publicity Office and Mit Ghamr suburbs documentation office under Dakahlia; this is evidence of a local registration service, not parcel-vector access.

The Official Gazette document hosted by Egypt’s State Information Service amends the detailed planning map for Mit al-Ezz village, Mit Ghamr Center. Its scope is that village and planning streets/plots, not the WUP city point’s complete cadastral coverage.

The Egyptian Tax Authority’s official page identifies the Mit Ghamr II tax office and its administrative service area. This is supporting local administrative context only, not a land registry or cadastre.

searchQueries.query: ميت غمر مأمورية الشهر العقاري سجل عقاري خرائط مساحية خريطة قطع أراضي رسمي
